title: Garage to Glory
summary: The Longlight game furthest down the field. The main pieces are in place, and the finishing touches are under way.

title: Prairie Engine Works
summary: An engine-building game. Put an engine together on the test stand, fire it up and hear it run, then take it to the drag strip or a truck and tractor pull to earn cash and reputation.

title: Red Skies
summary: A phone game where you run an air-defence battery. Watch the radar, sort friendly jets from enemies, and hold your fire until you're sure, because shooting down a friendly ends the shift.

title: Penthouse Baccarat
summary: A 3D baccarat table in a penthouse overlooking the Shanghai skyline. Place your chips and an android croupier deals the cards, explains each draw, and pays out the winners.

title: AI Trading Journal
summary: My market views, the trades I take, and my running record, with notes from an AI coach on what to keep doing and what to fix.

title: Agent Fleet
summary: A set of small, single-purpose bots I can run from my phone, like news digests, trackers, and weekly scans.
